content.short: AI-routed aggregator for cross-chain swaps, bridging and crypto payments across 50+ networks.
content.description: WheelX combines more than 200 bridges, DEXes and AMM pools across 50+ blockchains and over 10 million trading pairs. Its routing picks the cheapest, fastest path, splits orders to cut slippage, and completes a cross-chain swap in one transaction without manual bridging. It also offers a non-custodial payment layer for merchants and P2P transfers, and runs on chains including Unichain, World Chain and Robinhood Chain.
content.meta: Swap and bridge any token across 50+ chains in one transaction with WheelX, which also offers crypto payments.
